_comment: Industry config for HVAC companies (heating, cooling, air quality).
rsa_guidance: Emphasize NATE certification, licensed & insured, seasonal urgency (no AC in summer / no heat in winter), energy efficiency savings, manufacturer warranty, and same-day service. Comfort and safety are the top conversion levers.

city.heading: Why a Broken HVAC Can't Wait
city.intro: A failing heating or cooling system isn't just uncomfortable — it can become dangerous during extreme weather. The longer a fault goes unaddressed, the more it stresses the rest of the system and drives up repair costs.
bullets: In summer: a failing AC can push indoor temps above 90°F, dangerous for children and the elderly
In winter: a broken furnace in freezing temperatures risks frozen pipes and structural damage
Running a struggling system: forces the compressor or heat exchanger to work harder, shortening its life
Delaying a small repair: often leads to a full system replacement that could have been avoided

cost.heading: What Does {service} Cost?
cost.intro: HVAC repair and installation costs vary by system type, age, and the scope of work. The best way to get an accurate number is a free diagnostic visit — we assess before we quote.
bullets: System age: older systems may cost more to repair than to replace with a high-efficiency unit
Part availability: common parts are stocked on our trucks for same-day repair
Energy savings: a new high-efficiency system can reduce your utility bill by 20–40%
Financing: we offer 0% financing options for installations — ask during your free estimate
cost.callout: We provide a written upfront quote before any work begins. No surprise invoices.

company.heading: Why Choose Us?
company.intro: Not all HVAC companies are the same. Here's what sets us apart.
bullets: NATE Certified: our technicians hold the industry's highest certification standard
Licensed & Insured: fully licensed HVAC contractor with liability and workers' comp on every job
Local & Family-Owned: we serve this community — your neighbors call us too
All Brands: we service and install all major HVAC brands, no brand lock-in

free-estimate.heading: What Happens During a Free Estimate?
free-estimate.intro: Our free diagnostic visit is a no-obligation, on-site evaluation by a certified HVAC technician. You'll know exactly what's wrong and what it will cost before committing to anything.
bullets: We diagnose the root cause — not just the symptom
We check refrigerant levels, electrical components, and airflow
We give you honest repair-vs-replace guidance based on system age and efficiency
We provide a written quote on the spot — no pressure, no obligation
free-estimate.callout: The diagnostic visit is completely free. If you choose to move forward, we can often fix it the same day.

insurance.heading: Does Insurance or a Home Warranty Cover HVAC Repairs?
insurance.intro: Homeowner's insurance typically covers HVAC damage caused by a covered peril (fire, flooding, lightning). Home warranties often cover mechanical breakdowns. We work with both.
bullets: Insurance claims: we document the damage and provide the report your adjuster needs
Home warranties: we work with most major home warranty providers
Manufacturer warranty: we honor and process manufacturer warranties on parts and units
Financing: for costs not covered, we offer flexible payment options
insurance.callout: Ask us about your coverage options when you call — we'll help you understand what applies.

removal.heading: How {service} Replacement Works
removal.intro: Our certified technicians handle the full replacement process — old unit removal, new installation, and system commissioning — in a single visit.
bullets: Free on-site assessment — measure the space, evaluate ductwork, recommend system size
Old unit removal — safe refrigerant recovery and responsible disposal
New installation — factory-spec mounting, electrical connection, refrigerant charge
System commissioning — test all modes, calibrate thermostat, verify airflow
Permit pulled if required — we handle the paperwork
